Uber for Business is looking for a sharp, highly motivated Enterprise Account Executive to join our team, focusing on the CPG, Retail, and Heavy Industry verticals. This is a role for a \"hunter\" who can navigate the complex, often messy world of large-scale corporate logistics and turn ambiguity into growth.

You won't just be selling a platform; you'll be reimagining how the largest companies in the region move their employees and goods-from late-night shift commutes to high-volume voucher campaigns for the automotive industry.
Working here means solving high-stakes problems in real-time. You'll need to balance short-term execution sprints with a long-term vision for whitespace accounts with over 5,000 employees. The pace is fast, and the expectations for ownership are higher.

Success requires a blend of strategic thinking to break into new territories and the grit to push through long, multi-stakeholder contract negotiations. If you're energized by the challenge of tailoring consumer-loved products like Rides and Eats into mission-critical business solutions, this is where you'll grow.

Own and exceed aggressive sales targets by creatively prospecting into Enterprise accounts with 5,000+ employees, identifying decision-makers, and uncovering hidden business drivers.
Develop and execute robust territory and account plans to break into whitespace accounts, managing the end-to-end sales cycle from qualification to contract negotiation and closing.
Listen deeply to customer pain points and craft winning narratives that align the Uber for Business value proposition with their specific operational needs.
Forecast and manage your sales pipeline with high accuracy using Salesforce CRM, ensuring consistent activity and lead velocity.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, and Implementation leads to ensure every account launch is \"A+\" and delivers immediate value.
Navigate and unblock complex negotiations with Procurement, Finance, and HR leaders to position Uber as a critical infrastructure partner.

5+ years of B2B sales experience in a client-facing role, ideally within a SaaS or high-growth technology environment.
Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and managing complex sales cycles within Large Corporations/Enterprise segments.
Proficiency in using Salesforce CRM for pipeline management and forecasting.
Demonstrated ability to conduct strategic territory and account planning.
Advanced English proficiency and Portuguese fluency.

Deep understanding of the CPG, Retail, or Heavy Industry landscape in Brazil.
Experience selling consumption-based technology or \"Anything-as-a-Service\" (XaaS) solutions.
Established relationships with Travel Directors, Commute Managers, or Procurement leaders in the Enterprise segment.
Experience with a structured sales framework or methodology (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger).
Resilience and a \"builder\" mindset with the ability to navigate market adversity and ongoing product development.
Ready to Ride?
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Our Background
Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people.

Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems.

We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.
Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.
Why It Matters
Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.
But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. The Account Executive will own the commercial relationship for existing business, be responsible for identifying and closing upsell opportunities, have a relationship with budget owners and key decision makers, and own the renewal process. About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

You take a booked demo and turn it into a live, transacting Nivoda customer. That means running a compelling demo of the marketplace, navigating commercial negotiation, closing the contract, shepherding the customer through KYC/onboarding compliance, and owning the account through its first 90 days — first search, first order, first reorder.
This is not a pure "close and toss" role. The first 90 days are where marketplace customers form habits or churn silently, so you are accountable for activation, not just signature. You need to understand how two-sided marketplaces work — liquidity, supply trust, transaction mechanics — and ideally how the jewellery trade buys.
What will you be doing? 😎
Run discovery-led demos that map Nivoda's marketplace to the retailer's actual buying workflow.
Manage the deal: proposal, commercial terms, objection handling, multi-stakeholder buy-in, close.
Drive KYC and compliance to completion without letting momentum die — chase documents, unblock friction.
Own days 0–90: get the customer searching, quoting, and placing first orders; set usage habits early.
Coordinate with SDRs on handoff quality and with AMs on a clean day-90 transition (account context, buying patterns, risks).
Forecast accurately and keep pipeline stages honest.
What do we need from you? 💪
3–6 years closing experience, with background in a marketplace (B2B or transactional B2C — think platforms where you sold liquidity and trust, not just software) or in the jewellery/diamond industry with commercial exposure.
You understand marketplace dynamics: why the first transaction matters more than the contract, how supply breadth wins deals, what makes buyers switch procurement behaviour.
Strong demo craft: you sell workflows and outcomes, not feature tours.
Comfortable with operational follow-through — KYC, onboarding, activation — because signature is the midpoint, not the finish line.
Structured negotiator; calm with pushback on pricing and terms.
KPIs
Demo-to-close conversion, closed contracts/new business revenue
KYC completion time
90-day activation rate (first order + reorder)
Day-90 account value at handoff
Forecast accuracy
